set.body:
Goal: extend effectagram one level upstream without making it a first-level modelling monolith.

The anchor is plan_relation(study, model, effect_map, observation_model), whose scientific identity is separate from the compiled design receipt and realized fit identity.

The epic must deliver condition-vocabulary effect maps, typed observation and event facts, explicit sampling and independence assumptions, route-stable identity, a conformance contract for fmridesign and fmrireg, and an end-to-end raw-observation demonstration.

The existing lm_relation_fit path remains a compatibility adapter. BIDS is an adapter into the typed core, not the core model.

The present-tense estimability repair remains tracked by bd-01KZY9HQ0QSV0WEAR4NV7Z4VRJ and must not wait for this epic.
set.title: Epic: Build the first-moment relation compiler and ingestion contract
